pages.title: A Chicken in Your Pocket
pages.text: Every Modern Chickens breed can exist as an $(l)item$(), not just as a mob. A chicken item remembers its $(l)breed$(), its $(l)growth$(), $(l)gain$() and $(l)strength$() stats, and whether it is a rooster.$(br2)Machines in this book only accept chickens in item form.

pages.title: Stats
pages.text: $(l)Growth$() controls how fast a chick matures.$(br)$(l)Gain$() controls how much a chicken drops each cycle.$(br)$(l)Strength$() controls how fast it lays.$(br2)All three run from 1 to 10. Breeding two parents tends to push these numbers upward, so keeping your best birds pays off.
